2025_328_tsd_administration_building_cat.paragraph: Vendor quote 1460.001 (Project 1460) from Interior Systems Contract Group Inc. (ISCG) of Royal Oak, Michigan, printed September 25, 2025, proposing Category A furniture for the Troy School District administration building at 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098. The 254-line proposal is priced off State of Michigan MiDEAL seating contract #240000000497 and open office contract #22000000043, covering Haworth workstations, task and lounge seating, Compose panel systems and casegoods. The quote shows a subtotal of 238,597.99, total tax of 0.00, a total amount of USD 238,597.99, and a deposit required of 95,439.20, on terms of 50% deposit, balance net 30.
2025_328_tsd_administration_building_cat.page:
**Document type and origin**
Furniture quotation issued by Interior Systems Contract Group Inc. (ISCG), 612 N. Main St., Royal Oak, MI 48067; phone (248)399-1600; fax (248)399-1601; www.iscginc.com. Quote number 1460.001, Project 1460, Date Printed Sep 25, 2025. Carried on the Troy Board of Education agenda of October 14, 2025 as the TSD Administration Building Category A proposal.

**Parties**

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sold To | 10934-00 Troy School District, 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098 US |
| Bill To | 10934-00 Troy School District, 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098 US, Attn: Accounts Payable |
| Install Location | 10934-00 Troy School District, 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098 US |
| Project contact | Troy Schools Admin, Nives Kajtazovic |
| Terms | 50% deposit, balance net 30 |

**Contract vehicles**
Pricing comes from the State of Michigan MiDEAL program: seating contract #240000000497 and open office contract #22000000043. A note states ISCG will hold pricing for 90 days absent a manufacturer price increase and/or surcharges and tariffs; if such conditions exist ISCG may provide updated pricing. A further line reads "PRICING SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY TIME DUE TO TARIFFS."

**Scope**
254 numbered lines of Haworth product and services, tagged by room or zone: 102, 120, 121, 137, 138, 143, 154, COR C1, CR 103, CR 119, CR 136, CR 146, OFFICES, WRK 131, WRK 139_145, WRK 145, OFF_WRK, PM, SURCHARGE and P8719. Product families include Cabana and Poppy lounge, Zody and Zody LX task seating, Soji task chairs, Maari chairs, Breck stools, Jive and Planes tables, Upside and Upside+ height-adjustable bases and tops, Immerse conference tables, Masters Series casegoods, X Series pedestals, lockers and lateral files, and Compose panel frames, tiles, trim and glass toppers. Recurring finishes are River Cherry laminate, Patterned Linen Classic, Smoke, Graphite, Metallic Silver, Chrome, Pixel Dice and clear tempered 6mm glass.

**Priced services, surcharges and totals**

| Line | Item | Amount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 249 | Project management | 1,000.00 |
| 250 | Haworth seating tariff surcharge | 3,126.66 |
| 251 | Haworth open office tariff surcharge | 12,067.30 |
| 252 | Labor to receive, deliver and install per MiDEAL seating contract | 3,795.00 |
| 253 | Labor to receive, deliver and install per MiDEAL open office contract | 15,575.00 |
| 254 | Comment: monthly storage cost for furniture after 30 days | 0.00 (note: $1250) |
| - | Subtotal | 238,597.99 |
| - | Total tax | 0.00 |
| - | Total Amount - USD | 238,597.99 |
| - | Deposit Required | 95,439.20 |

Labor notes on lines 252 and 253 specify normal business hours and non-union labor, tagged P8719. The quote states it expires on September 25, 2025.

**Terms and conditions**
Twenty numbered clauses follow the pricing. The proposal is not binding unless signed by an authorized representative of the Buyer and accepted by an ISCG manager. Product is not cancelable or returnable. Tariffs imposed after order placement plus applicable sales and use taxes are added at invoicing and are the Buyer's responsibility. Product held for a Buyer unable to accept delivery is warehoused 30 days at no charge; beyond that, storage charges apply. Interest accrues at the higher of 18% per annum or the maximum rate permitted by law. ISCG retains a security interest until paid in full and may file a UCC-I. Disputes go to the Rules of the American Arbitration Association. Credit-card payments above $2,000 carry an additional fee equal to 2.0% of the amount charged. A Remit To and signature block closes the document.

Installation is during normal business hours with non-union labor, with overtime or union labor billed extra. ISCG holds a security interest until paid in full and may file a UCC-I, and is not responsible for a manufacturer's inability to meet estimated ship dates. Buyer must provide a free and clear job site, elevator service and offloading facilities at no charge and secure all building permits, bears risk of loss after delivery, and must carry fire and extended coverage insurance on full value with loss payable to ISCG. Manufacturer warranties are assigned to Buyer to the extent assignable, with no other warranties. Disputes are settled under the Rules of the American Arbitration Association, and Buyer pays ISCG's attorney fees and enforcement costs. VISA, MasterCard or American Express use for deposits or invoice payments above $2,000 is assessed an additional fee equal to 2.0% of the amount charged. The Proposal and Terms and Conditions are the entire agreement and may not be changed without ISCG Management's written authorization. A Remit To line and a signature block conclude the quote.
